factProposals.value: Billing accounts are retrieved from Caselle over HTTP with timeouts and capped retries.
When Caselle cannot be reached, a billing request shows an error saying the connection failed.
Every billing transaction is logged with a timestamp and user ID.

decisions.statement: Billing is read from Caselle, not copied into this system.
decisions.rationale: Caselle stays the system of record for billing

limitations.statement: Tested only against a SIMULATED Caselle stand-in; the interface is this project's own and must be mapped to Caselle's real API.
The other REQ-011 integrations (Granicus/311, ComplianceGO, Bluebeam, Utilisync, XpressBillPay) are not built.
